findings.text: [P3] The receipt paragraphs claims each named log "names its source revision, resolved tree, imported promotion module and command", but logs/reproduction.log and logs/base-cohort.log carry no such header — only the other three do — so the base arm (4 failed, 402 passed), which is the measurement the zero-added-failures claim rests on, is asserted in prose rather than shown, and a later reader cannot tell from the log which revision produced it.

[P3] _landing_commit_paths(repository) still defaults to final HEAD in test_promotion_appends_no_second_comment_when_the_worker_authored_the_record, so the set it asserts is the release receipt's file list rather than the landing's — the same misread this node repaired in three sibling cases — and it can no longer detect a landing that also stages the plan file, because the receipt's list satisfies it; the comment assertion just above it still catches an appended comment, so the exposure is narrow and predates this change.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit — 10632d40 replaces the HEAD read in the three cases with the located landing and gives _landing_commit_paths a revision parameter (27 insertions, 7 replaced, no assertion text dropped), and 577c78df appends the section record and the evidence anchor as additions only (81 insertions, 0 deletions) with the plan-version and plan-modified metas untouched.
item_verdicts.done_when: Each clause was read against its artefact: the three named cases are red at base 789ef768 (logs/reproduction.log, HEAD subject 'release(r-20260914T190322000000-verdict): record workspace outcome', 3 failed 47 deselected) and the 22-module cohort moves from 4 failed 402 passed to 1 failed 405 passed at 10632d40 with the ids in logs/base-failure-ids.txt and logs/head-failure-ids.txt (3 resolved, 0 added, 1 retained outside the fence), and the named files pass whole — 55 passed, which my own bounded re-run at 577c78df reproduced in a scratch copy (logs/review-gate-head.log).
item_verdicts.goal: The node's goal is to update the three promotion-history assertions in tests/test_crew_promotion.py to find the promote commit by its recorded sha instead of final HEAD; tests/test_crew_promotion.py:1539 adds _promotion_commit(repository, run_id), which locates the landing by the promote(<run_id>): subject because complete() records no revision (reckon/crew/promotion.py:2073 returns only committed, subject and paths), and the three cases at :1587, :1614 and :1880 read that revision rather than HEAD for both the subject, body and file-list assertions.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read whole; its five gate logs exist under the run's logs directory, its negative control carries its reason, and its special report of the 19:06:28 whole-tree ruff format names 97 restored paths (logs/format-noise-paths.txt) of which neither commit contains one, but the base arm it reports is not self-identifying: logs/reproduction.log and logs/base-cohort.log carry no revision, tree, module or command header while logs/head-cohort.log does.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The range 789ef768..577c78df touches exactly three files — tests/test_crew_promotion.py, docs/evidence/archive/the-ledger-is-one-file-per-run-landed.html and docs/plans/the-ledger-is-one-file-per-run.html — every one inside the four declared paths, with reckon/crew/promotion.py unedited and the reviewed worktree clean at 577c78df.

justifications.durability: The repair's guard is shown red without the repair — logs/reproduction.log fails at base 789ef768 on the receipt subject 'release(r-20260914T190322000000-verdict): record workspace outcome' — and each case reddens if promotion's subject, verdict or landed file list changes (tests/test_crew_promotion.py:1588-1595), with the bounded weakness that one sibling at :1843 still reads final HEAD.
justifications.evidence: The gate measures the done_when and records every result — reproduction, both cohort arms, both id inventories and the 55-case gate my re-run reproduced at 577c78df (logs/review-gate-head.log) — but the base-arm log the delta rests on carries no revision header, contrary to the claim the evidence record makes for it at docs/evidence/archive/the-ledger-is-one-file-per-run-landed.html:532.
justifications.fit: The helper sits beside the one it generalises at tests/test_crew_promotion.py:1535-1539, keeps the file's leading-underscore local-helper idiom with a docstring saying why HEAD cannot name the landing, and introduces no name the repository rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_crew_promotion.py:1587, :1614 and :1880 each locate the landing commit before every subject and file-list read, and the subject route is the implementable one because reckon/crew/promotion.py:2073 records no revision — the goal's "recorded sha" names a fact no record carries.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 789ef768..577c78df names only the three declared paths, both docs commits are additions only, and the reviewed worktree carries no residue of the format incident the manifest self-reports.
